construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Water pressing Fire same-polarity — the extinguishing force that doesn't moderate itself
candidates.k2_overview: Your Water moves as the General: force that arrives as tide. You command indirectly, positioning, timing, the pressure of inevitability, and opponents find themselves outflanked by someone who never raised a voice. Strategy is your sword arm. The deep game, played patiently, with the current doing the marching.
candidates.k2_functional: Your discipline moves like a cold current: quiet, total, and felt only when someone crosses it.

k2_domain_readings.Pressure: You convert pressure into depth: threats make you quieter and more exact. Beware pressure you keep underwater. Even oceans need to storm occasionally.
k2_domain_readings.Command: You command by current: framing choices, shaping terrain, letting people arrive at your conclusion. It is masterful and unsettling. Show the hand sometimes. Trust grows where strategy is visible.
k2_domain_readings.Crisis: In crisis you flow while others freeze: instant rerouting, calm surface, decisive undertow. You will save situations quietly and collect credit never. Log your victories somewhere. Currents deserve historians.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, the pull stays faint until pressure comes. Your rank is earned on hard days more than calm ones.

angles.drive: You get clearer the harder things press, because only pressure stops your guessing. Inside a crisis you want the next move more than the right feeling. Your calm in the worst hour gives everyone else somewhere to stand.
angles.cost_self: Clear-headed in crisis is the self you trust. Since calm gives you nothing to push on, you chase the next crisis rather than rest in a quiet one. Ordinary days pass you by half-lived, along with the slow gains they hold.
angles.cost_others: In a crisis you take the clear head and every decision. Deciding fast feels safer than watching anyone decide slowly, so you carry the whole crisis rather than share it. The people beside you come through it without ever handling the hard part.

angles.drive: You pick your moment instead of taking the first one offered. Force spent early feels wasted, so a moment picked well beats three taken early. Your single well-timed move often does the work of a whole week of pushing.
angles.cost_self: Picking the moment keeps you from wasting yourself. You hold a move until the moment is certain rather than good enough, since an early move cannot be undone. Some of your best chances go to people quicker off the mark.
angles.cost_others: The moment is yours alone to pick. You would rather keep the plan until the moment than explain it, and you leave the people you lead without a signal. Those who follow you spend the waiting hours guessing what comes next.

angles.drive: You lead without shouting, often without anyone noticing. You would sooner be right than be obeyed, and you lead by arranging the outcome rather than asking. Under your hand a team runs smoothly, and few people guess why.
angles.cost_self: Leading without shouting keeps you out of the argument. Because you would rather lead quietly than be seen asking, you leave your name off most of what you steered. The credit, and the rank that comes with it, goes to someone louder than you.
angles.cost_others: Arranging beats asking whenever you lead. Leading without shouting feels cleaner than a request someone can refuse, and you give the people you steer no yes or no. Your people travel a calm road and never feel pushed along it.

friction.define: As a friction, each rule becomes a demand on you. Falling short feels worse than strain to you, and the weight is seldom set down.

angles.drive: You go cold rather than say what hurt. Going cold keeps you in charge of the hurt, and silence gives no one a way back in. Keep in mind that you go cold wanting someone to come and find you.
angles.cost_self: Going cold keeps the upper hand without a word. Since a fight means admitting you were hurt, you would rather go cold than lose the argument. You stay cold long after the fight ends, and you lose closeness with every cold day.
angles.cost_others: Whenever someone crosses you, you go cold on them first. You turn cold rather than show an anger that can be answered, and you take away their only way to fix it. You leave them to guess at a fault you never name.

angles.drive: You are harder on yourself than anyone has been. You would rather catch a fault first than be told, and you are hard on your work before anyone else can be. You take the blame early and never stay long enough for praise.
angles.cost_self: Your own work gets the hardest judge you know. Since pleasure in your work feels like dropping your guard, you stay hard on it rather than enjoy it. You pay for being this hard in rest you skip, because nothing you make gets to count.
angles.cost_others: Hard on yourself never stays on yourself. You hold the people close to you to the same hard line rather than a kinder one, since you never let yourself off. You bring that line home and leave them no pass for a bad day.

angles.drive: You never let up, on anything or anyone. Since letting up feels like losing, you keep the pressure on rather than call the job done. Remember that you are allowed to let up once a thing is finished.
angles.cost_self: Never letting up is how you prove you belong. Because rest reads as falling behind, you would rather stay under pressure than put it down for a night. You settle the cost of never letting up in sleep, and the body sends the bill.
angles.cost_others: Letting up is something you refuse the people beside you as well. You would rather share the pressure than let up alone, and you keep them at your pace. Never letting up, you spend their evenings as freely as your own.

edge.lead: Water runs through your career, your health and your growth. It is the cool that comes over you when voices rise, the straight look you take at what your body is telling you, and the one quiet move that changes everything after it.
